mapper.select: SELECT eh.eh_num AS id, eh.eh_type_name AS type, eh.eh_exp AS exp, DATE_FORMAT(eh.eh_created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS date, eh.eh_current_lv AS currentLv, eh.eh_is_level_up AS isLevelUp FROM exp_history eh JOIN `character` ch ON eh.ch_num = ch.ch_num WHERE ch.user_num = #{userNum} ORDER BY eh.eh_created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exp_history eh JOIN `character` ch ON eh.ch_num = ch.ch_num WHERE ch.user_num = #{userNum}
